description: The plot illustrates the loss of various models over the number of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (navy blue, solid). All lines exhibit a decreasing trend in loss as the number of iterations increases, starting from around 3.4 at 0 iterations and decreasing to values between 2.5 and 2.6 at 140000 iterations. The Vanilla model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.6, while StrmLLM (n=64) starts at 3.4 and ends at about 2.55. SepLLM (n=64) starts at 3.3 and ends at roughly 2.55, SepLLM (n=64, H) begins at 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.54, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) starts at 3.3 and ends at around 2.53, and SepLLM (n=128) starts at 3.3 and ends at about 2.52. Each line decreases rapidly in the initial iterations and then gradually levels off.
